d:
The Cavaliers defeated the 76ers, 119-95 tonight in Cleveland. Donovan Mitchell contributed a team-high 23 points to go with 8 assists 7 rebounds and 2 steals, with Evan Mobley of the Cavaliers adding an additional 22 points (8-13 FG, 3-4 3P) in the game. Jaylen Brown finished with a team-high 20 points along with 5 rebounds for the 76ers in the losing effort. The Cavaliers improve their record to 5-4 with the win, while the 76ers fall to 8-2 for the season.
